items.summary: Recommendation: drain existing execution, repair, and measurement backlog before creating new implementation work. The 30-day scorecard shows 174 approved proposals without execution, 8 failed requests, 46 open failure follow-ups, and 24 deployed improvements awaiting measurement; the action mandate currently reports no eligible candidate. Revenue evidence is one day only (2026-09-21): $4.92 aggregate commission, not site-attributable. Unknown: incremental revenue, ROI, margin, and causal lift. Smallest next step: CTO/principal-engineer triage the approved backlog and failed requests, while CEO continues measurement. One owner decision remains: authorize or decline sending the prepared Woot permissions request for SearchWoot; public launch remains blocked.

Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private. Official Woot documentation confirms API access but not commercial redistribution, public display, caching, historical derivatives, or alerts; public terms point against those uses. Legal, security, accuracy, privacy, and measurement gates remain incomplete. Smallest next step is owner approval to send the already-prepared permission request; no production or external action is otherwise authorized.
